summary: xAI announced that Gopuff's new in-app AI shopping assistant, Go, is powered by Grok's text, audio, and image models along with xAI's API tools.

mechanisms.reason: The document describes a consumer-facing shopping agent that builds carts and acts on a user's behalf, but this is a single customer deployment, not an industry-scale shift.
mechanisms.quote: Go is available now in the Gopuff app on iOS and Android, starting in the US with the UK to follow.

categories.reason: A consumer delivery marketplace is integrating an AI agent directly into its shopping and fulfillment experience.
categories.quote: Gopuff and SpaceXAI launched Go, an AI-powered shopping assistant built into the Gopuff app and powered by Grok text, audio, and image models.
